Follow the [public-API testing rule](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-python-genai/blob/main/instrumentation/AGENTS.md#tests), using the existing sync/async `messages.create()` tests as the pattern.

`Omit` is already exported at the supported floor (`anthropic==0.51.0` has `from ._types import NOT_GIVEN, Omit, ...` in `__init__`), only the lowercase `omit` instance is newer. So this can be a plain import (`from anthropic import NotGiven, Omit`) and the `import anthropic` / `getattr` can go:

```suggestion
_T = TypeVar("_T")

_UNSET_TYPES = (NotGiven, Omit)
```

+_AnthropicOmit = getattr(anthropic, "Omit", None)
+_UNSET_TYPES = (
+    (NotGiven,) if _AnthropicOmit is None else (NotGiven, _AnthropicOmit)
+)
